Description
IS 1239 GI Pipe
IS 1239
 is an Indian Standard specification established by the 
Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)
 for 
mild steel tubes
, 
galvanized iron (GI) pipes
, and 
fittings
. It is commonly used for water, gas, and air line applications, especially in domestic and industrial sectors.
Key Features of IS 1239
1. Full Name:
IS 1239 – Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings
2. Parts of the Standard:
IS 1239 Part 1
: Covers 
mild steel tubes
 for water, gas, air, and steam.
IS 1239 Part 2
: Covers 
mild steel tubulars and other wrought steel pipe fittings
.
3. Material:
Made from mild steel with specified mechanical and chemical properties.
4. Sizes:
Nominal bore sizes typically range from 
6 mm to 150 mm
.
5. Types of Pipes:
Light (Class A)
Medium (Class B)
Heavy (Class C)
The classification is based on wall thickness.
6. End Connections:
Pipes can have 
plain ends
, 
screwed ends
, or 
sockets
.
7. Common Applications:
Water and gas transportation
Scaffolding
HVAC systems
Structural applications
Fire fighting systems
